purpose: Third-party UI assets vendored for the loopback-only operator dashboard (templates/dashboard.html). Served only through web_app.py's loopback-guarded /assets/{name} allowlist route; no CDN reference remains.

assets.notes: adminlte.min.css compiles in Bootstrap 5.3 CSS, so Bootstrap's MIT license is carried alongside. Only the stylesheet is vendored: AdminLTE's JavaScript (sidebar/treeview/fullscreen behaviour, localStorage for sidebar state) and Bootstrap's JavaScript are not needed by this single-page panel and are deliberately not included. The file's trailing sourceMappingURL comment points at a local .map that is not vendored; browsers only request it with devtools open, and the request stays on loopback (404).
License file only; Bootstrap's CSS reaches the page through adminlte.min.css.

security_review.network_or_telemetry_code: none found. adminlte.min.css contains no @import and no external url(); its only http(s) strings are license/website comments and the SVG XML namespace in inline data: URIs.
